sections.heading: Forming the gérondif
sections.body:
The **gérondif** is *en* + the **present participle** (the -ant form). To form the participle, take the *nous* form of the present, remove **-ons**, add **-ant**:

- *nous parlons* → *parlant* → ***en parlant***
- *nous finissons* → *finissant* → *en finissant*
- *nous faisons* → *faisant* → *en faisant*
- *nous prenons* → *prenant* → *en prenant*

Three irregular: *être* → *étant*, *avoir* → *ayant*, *savoir* → *sachant*. Spelling: *manger* → *en mangeant*, *commencer* → *en commençant*.

sections.heading: What it expresses
sections.body:
The gérondif always refers to the **subject of the main verb**, and can express:

- **simultaneity** — two things at once: *Il chante en prenant sa douche.* (He sings while taking a shower.) *Ne parle pas en mangeant !* Add *tout* to stress a contrast: *Tout en travaillant beaucoup, elle trouve le temps de lire.* (While working a lot, she still finds time to read.)
- **manner, means** — how: *Il est entré en courant.* (He ran in.) *J'ai appris le français en regardant des films.* (I learned French by watching films.)
- **condition** — if: ***En partant** maintenant, tu arriveras à l'heure.* (If you leave now, you'll be on time.)
- **time** — when: ***En arrivant** à la gare, j'ai vu Hugo.* (When I arrived at the station, I saw Hugo.)

sections.heading: Watch the subject
sections.body: The gérondif must have the same subject as the main verb: *J'ai vu Hugo en sortant du cinéma* means **I** was coming out of the cinema. If Hugo was, say *J'ai vu Hugo qui sortait du cinéma.*

vocab: to go out, to come out
examples: Il chante en prenant sa douche.
He sings while taking a shower.
Ne parle pas en mangeant !
Don't talk while you're eating!
Il est entré en courant.
He ran in.
J'ai appris le français en regardant des films.
I learned French by watching films.
En partant maintenant, tu arriveras à l'heure.
If you leave now, you'll be on time.
En arrivant à la gare, j'ai vu Hugo.
When I arrived at the station, I saw Hugo.
Tout en travaillant beaucoup, elle trouve le temps de lire.
While working a lot, she still finds time to read.
On apprend en faisant des erreurs.
You learn by making mistakes.
Elle écoute de la musique en travaillant.
She listens to music while she works.
En lisant cet article, j'ai compris le problème.
Reading this article, I understood the problem.
Il s'est blessé en faisant du ski.
He hurt himself skiing.
En étant patient, tu y arriveras.
By being patient, you'll get there.
